Of course, places like the Dragon Academy, or a Dragon Lord’s Domain were an exception, but those weren’t composed of a single building, unlike the Museum. Rey and Lucielle walked out of their corner, and he took a good look at the massive structure with a small smile.
’I wonder if Alicia would have loved coming here… to see what they could possibly have inside.’
He knew how much she loved Museums and historical landmarks, after all.
’It won’t be much of a date, especially since this is the enemy’s territory, but I’m sure she’d really enjoy herself.’ Looking closely at the Museum, it really did resemble Earth’s building structure.
It would have been the perfect place to spend more time with her.
’But… time has run out.’ Rey sighed, shrugging silently. ’It’s time for her to go…’
"What’s on your mind?" Lucielle asked, her arm still wrapped around his despite the teleportation now being complete.
She was also close—much too close for comfort—to him. Their bodies were literally brushing past each other with even the slightest movement. Rey couldn’t complain, though, since it didn’t seem like Lucielle had noticed or thought it was a big deal.
Why would he point it out and make things awkward between them?
"I’m fine. Just…"
"I saw you looking at the Museum. I didn’t think you liked places like this."
"Well…" He shrugged in response. "... Let’s just say I’ve taken a liking to them in recent times."
"Ohhh?"
Rey could see Lucielle’s smile broadening as she gave him a sly smile. Whatever was going on in her mind was probably going to be something crazy.
"After this is all done, why don’t the both of us go inside?"
"Are you crazy?"
"A little… yeah." She laughed, causing Rey to nearly slap himself in the face.
"For one, we don’t know when we’ll be done with our task. Secondly… it’s even closed because of the whole event taking place today."
"…"
"Besides, we can hardly see anyone around… which means the whole Capital is experiencing some kind of curfew. Maybe it’s because of the Exhibition or the fact that the Dragon Emperor showed his first. Either way… I don’t think we can—"
"Dude… if you didn’t want to go, you could have just said so." Lucielle sighed, removing her hand from his, quickly folding them as she frowned.
"What? When did I ever say that?"
"Ahh… my apologies. If you didn’t want to go WITH ME, then you could have just said so."
"How does that make what you said any better?" Rey was exasperated at this point, so he slightly raised the volume of his tone.
However, moments later, those feelings were suppressed.
"Haaa… nevermind." Lucielle shrugged. "Let’s just go."
Rey was tempted to simply let the matter die, but something told him that he would sorely regret it if he did that. And so, he swiftly grabbed her hand and pulled her closer the moment she quickened her pace.
"Hold on a moment. Just explain yourself, because I have no idea what’s going on right now or what I did wrong."
All he did was state the facts.
How did he manage to piss off someone like Lucielle, who should have understood?
"You just keep making excuses not to go in. How does a mere Museum being closed stop the two of us from heading in? Isn’t it even better that way, since we’ll have the place all to ourselves?"
Rey was stunned by her response.
"Do you think I didn’t notice that it was closed… or that the Capital is experiencing some sort of curfew right now? You must think I’m dumb or something… ahh…" Lucielle’s frown slowly dissipated and she turned away from Rey.
Once again, her cheeks were reddened.
"... Sorry about that."
"...."
It was now Rey’s turn to be silent as he looked at the girl that stood right beside him.
They had spent months together—getting to know each other, learning so much about their likes, dislikes, tastes, preferences… and so much more. Lucielle got to know what Earth was like before the accident, and Rey learned a lot more about H’Trae.
They had gotten much closer than ever… which meant certain feelings would naturally progress as their relationship advanced.
’Lucielle’s feelings for me are yet to recede.’ Rey thought to himself as he watched her avert her gaze.
He didn’t know whether or not to feel bad about this.
It was somewhat similar with what he experienced with Esme—the conflict of liking someone, but also loving another.
’I still love Alicia. I have tried to move on, but… it wouldn’t be fair for anyone if I just made them my rebound when I haven’t fully gotten over the one I really love.’
~I don’t mind being your rebound, Master!~
At this point, Emil swiftly made her move, but was instantly turned down by Rey.
’No!’
~Ahh… dammit. I will never give up, though!~
Rey sighed and shook his head. ’What a mess. When did I start having girl problems like this anyway?’
He took one of Lucielle’s hands, breaking her pose with just a single move.
"You want to see the Museum, right? Let’s go right now."
"W-what?!" Her face instantly turned red. "B-but don’t we have to go… do t-the thing with the—?"
"That can wait. I have time powers anyway…"
"B-but…!"
"Now look at you making excuses." Rey grinned broadly at her. "Something tells me you don’t want to do this…"
"W-what? No way!"
At this point, Lucielle pushed herself closer to Rey and locked her arm with his, clasping her fingers with his as she smiled daringly. Rey felt his heart skip a beat for a moment before it finally stabilized.
With her pale, pretty face now close to his, and her crimson eyes glowing with excitement, she nodded emphatically and pointed at the large building.
"Let’s go!"
"That’s the spirit!"
The both of them then ran off to the building—already shrouded by a barrier that blocked any form of observation from an external audience. Even if someone passed right beside them, they wouldn’t be able to sense them in the slightest.
And so, with this power making sure they remained undetected, Rey and Lucielle used another special dose of Magic to grant themselves entry into the Museum and rush into the massive building together.
They both had excited smiles on their faces… and if anyone were to see them—whether from afar or in much closer proximity—they would think the two were a couple.
It… just seemed right to assume.
********
"Look at those two dawdling…" Adrien mumbled to himself with a smile as he watched the Museum from afar.
He could already see R’ai and Luc’ia entering the Museum—or rather… Rey and Lucielle.
Indeed, he knew the identity of Rey’s partner.
’He brought her without telling me, but I guess it makes sense for him to do so.’ His smile broadened as he watched them absolutely enjoy themselves.
Unlike the two, he was all alone—not that it mattered to him.
"This doesn’t affect the plan at all…"
*
*
*
[A/N]
Thanks for reading!
This isn’t me saying that they’re the final couple or anything. I just have to point that out…

chapters.title: Chapter 899: The Hero's Crusade
chapters.content:
Chapter 899: The Hero's Crusade
[Moments Earlier]
"At long last..."
Adonis stood before the massive Magic Circle that stood at the inner sanctum of the Chamber
of Ancients, his gaze completely fixed on the runic letters and ancient alphabets used in constructing the intricate formula.
He remembered just how difficult it was for both he and Lucielle to figure out how to configure it to their specifications.
However, this time was going to be different.
'I remember everything! I remember exactly what I have to do in order to get the same results as last time!' Adonis grinned to himself. 'I just need time...'
And, time was all he had at the moment.
'Everyone is too busy focusing on the Exhibition. There's no one to stop me here.'
With that train of thought, Adonis set aside all his baggage and worries, choosing instead to focus entirely on the work at hand.
He did away with his pathetic disguise as a Dragon, allowing his pure golden hair to flow beautifully without the restraint of a horn getting in the way. The disgusting tail that stuck to him vanished, and so did his wings.
Within seconds, he had reverted back to his original form-the Hero Adonis.
"Haa... let's begin."
It took hours the last time-grueling hours that were bought through the sacrifice of his dear friends and comrades.
Rey was among those friends...
However, thanks to his knowledge of the past, he didn't need hours any longer.
Minutes were all that was required.
As such, the whole process-embedding the equation into the Magic Circle, and ensuring the gateway stabilized-took nearly one hour to finalize.
Fifty-six minutes to be exact.
"It's finally done..." Adonis chuckled as he stared at the crackling Magic Circle that stood before him.
His months spent as a Dragon had finally paid off.
As much as he felt waves of happiness rise from within him, he couldn't also ignore the pangs of pain that swirled even deeper in his heart.
'I... didn't want to resort to this, everyone. But, there really is no other option here.'
Too many people had died, and so much had gone wrong.
'I underestimated the Dragonfly effect and made so many terrible decisions. My mistakes, as well as the tragedy of this reality... I will atone for them all by regressing once more.'
Adonis could only hope that he wouldn't have to do this again.
He could only pray.
'Here goes...' Inhaling deeply, Adonis prepared to undulate his suppressed energy in order to activate the Magic Circle and provide sufficient energy for his travels.
The last time, it was a combination of Lucielle's energy and several Mana Crystals that provided the energy, but Adonis had become so powerful that he could do it all by himself. He had been preparing for this for months, after all.
'Once I release all this energy, there's a high chance I could be detected... no, wait... the Chamber has a barrier that hides it from external interference.'
As such, no one from the outside was going to sense his energy output.
It wouldn't matter if they did, though.
'I'll be long gone by then.' He smirked, already releasing bits of his power.
Before he could continue with his task, though-
"Adonis...?"
-He heard a familiar voice.
Adonis felt his body freeze, with his eyes trembling as he felt the presence of two people in the vast hall.
"Rey... Lucielle..." He whispered, feeling the urge to turn back in order to look at them, yet refusing with all his might to do so.
He didn't-couldn't-allow them to break his resolve now.
"Adonis, what are you doing here?" Lucielle's voice echoed in the air, causing his body to grow even stiffer.
How could he possibly look at her face now?
Adonis took one step forward, determined more than ever to go on with his task and reset the current timeline. He had already played this scenario hundreds of times in his head, and he already knew the choice he was going for.
'I... I can't allow myself to stop now!'
The deaths of Eric, of everyone who perished due to his incompetence, still haunted him to this very moment. He constantly had nightmares, witnessing their dying moments over and
over again.
He wanted it to end.
'I... I can't be distracted by the present...' He took another step forward.
"Adonis! You're not even going to say any-?!"
"WHAT IS THERE TO SAY?!!" His loud voice suddenly echoed in the hall, causing a shockwave to spread throughout the chamber.
At this point, he could no longer resist the temptation.
He turned away from the Magic Circle and looked at his friends-Rey and Lucielle-standing side by side.
"It always had to end like this, huh? The three of us here again... the two of you standing side by side." He whispered to himself, his voice barely audible to anyone else who could have
possibly listened.
'Now that it has come to this, I can't back down.'
Clenching his fist and hardening his resolve, Adonis addressed the stunned faces of Rey and Lucielle-not as the friend they knew-but as the Hero he needed to be.
"Do not interfere, both of you." He began. "I am trying to change all of this... the present, the
damned future..."
"W-what are you-?"
Rey held Lucielle's shoulder, stopping her from finishing her query. He sighed as he stared at Adonis, completely calm as he uttered the next words.
"You're trying to regress."
Those words hit the nail on the head, causing Adonis' eyes to twitch slightly. However, he did
not break his composure.
"Yes... yes, I am."
|| ||
Lucielle's shocked face, and Rey's calm expression haunted him, but he remained resolute.
"Don't you understand what this means? I can save everyone! I... we did this before- together! If no, when I succeed at this, we will have Eric back... and Billy, and everyone
else who perished back then."
"Adonis..."
"I've done it before! I know exactly how it works! I just need you all to trust me! I won't fail
you this time!"
"... Adonis..."
"You two can even come with! Rey, you have more than enough energy, right? This time all
three of us can go together!"
"... No..."
"We can be a team again! We can do it the way I wanted us to from the start." At this point, Adonis was smiling, his wide eyes leaking out tears as he poured out his emotions. "We... we
could really save everyone."
He stretched out both hands, trembling, begging his comrades to take his hands.
The reason he didn't tell them about all of this sooner was because he didn't want to burden them with his responsibility, but since they had figured it out on their own, it was only right for him to present them with a choice.
-The choice to accompany him.
"The formula will have to go through revision, but since you're here Lucielle, we can work on
it together... like old times. We'll accommodate the two of you, and with all of us regressing,
we can change a lot more and save our comrades."
"Adonis..."
"We can save the worl—"
"No, we can't!" Rey's voice suddenly pierced the air, his glaring eyes focused solely on Adonis
as he made the declaration.
"We can't, because there's no such thing as Regression!"
*
*
*
[A/N]
Thanks for reading!
I hope you enjoyed the chapter. What a heated conflict this has become...

chapters.title: Chapter 900: Cruel Truth
chapters.content:
Chapter 900: Cruel Truth
"W-what... did you just say?"
Adonis had been so wrapped up in all his thoughts regarding his plans for the future- especially how they would change now that Rey and Lucielle could potentially be joining him.
This was, by no means, a bad thing.
However, adding two others would undoubtedly make things more complicated. Still, if they were up for the task, Adonis was more than happy to have them on this journey as allies to aid him on the quest to save the world.
All that mattered was that they completed the mission-no matter what!
"There is no such thing as regression, Adonis!" Rey hammered his words into his head once again. "You're not a regressor, at least... not in the real sense of the word. And... that Magic Circle isn't for regression."
"What are you sayi-?"
"I can see everything with my [Perfect Divine Appraisal], Adonis... and I see it perfectly now." He pointed at the Magic Circle.
"That thing is meant to travel worlds, not send you to the past."
"W-wha-?!"
"You wouldn't be regressing." Rey sighed. "You'd just be jumping ship to a new world."
11
Those words were mind shattering, especially coming from Rey.
But, that didn't make them true.
"You're wrong! I've regressed before! I have!" Adonis yelled out, taking a step back, so he could be much closer to the Magic Circle.
"You didn't truly regress..."
"No! I did! I di-!"
"I CAN SEE YOUR STATUS WINDOW, ADONIS!" Rey yelled out, his voice nearly sounding like a behemoth that would swallow him whole.
"You're not a Regressor... you're a Transmigrator."
[STATUS WINDOW]
- Name: Adonis Levi.
- Race: Human (Otherworlder) (Re: Transmigrator)
- Class: The Hero (S-Tier)
- Level: 300 (89.50% EXP)
- Life Force: 5,900 (+1,450) {5,000}
- Mana Level: 4,500 (+1,250) {5,000}
- Combat Ability: 7,000 (+2,000) {5,000}
- Stat Points: 0
- Skills (Exclusive): [Perfect Divine Sword Summon]. [Divine Defense]. [Divine Light Magic]. [Absolute Good Shall Prevail]. [Transmigration]
- Skills (Non-Exclusive): [Absolute Combat Application]. [Grand Magic Application]. [Absolute Mana Recovery]. [Perfect Full Sense]. [Grand Life Force Recovery]. [Heroic Power] - Alignment: Lawful Good
[Additional Information]
Your desire to save this world has transcended the very bounds of space-time itself, and now you are once again on the journey to protect those you love.
Good luck!
[End Of Information]
Rey's bright eyes narrowed as he looked at all the details that used to be full of glitches. They were no longer that way.
'I don't know what has changed...' He thought to myself. 'Could it be that my assimilation with the System has advanced? Or maybe it's because we're in the Chamber of Ancients.'
It didn't matter what the case was.
What mattered at the current moment was the truth.
"If you leave with that Magic Circle, you'll be bailing on us, Adonis." Rey said, his fist tightly clenched.
Adonis shook his head vehemently.
"No! No, you're wrong!"
Rey was... no, he HAD TO BE wrong!
'Everything I experienced in this world also happened in that last world. The only reason things became different is due to the Dragonfly effect. Because I changed things, the future also changed significantly...'
That was it!
"The Oracle told me, Adonis... that this world is like a linear story." Rey continued speaking, though Adonis closed his ears, not wanting to hear any of it.
"There is no way to 'return' to the past and change the present or future. It's just something that flows... like a pre-set narrative."
"No..."
"I still don't completely understand, but I know what I'm seeing, Adonis. You don't want to do this... to leave this world and your friends. To abandon your-"
"YOU'RE NOT MY FRIENDS!" Adonis screamed out in response. "If what you're saying is true, then you're not my friends and this is not my world! You're not the Rey Skylar I knew and loved, and you're not the Lucielle I respected and adored."
If he was nothing more than a Transmigrator, then... his world truly died and he had been too
busy saving another one.
"No... that can't be." Adonis couldn't just accept that.
He had to reject Rey's proposition.
"But it's the tru-"
"You mean to tell me that there is a world out there that is completely similar to ours? What next? Infinite realities? I regressed and became a baby, Rey! I lived an entire life on Earth before getting Transmigrated into another world like all of you."
He was indeed a Transmigrator... but he was also a Regressor.
How else could it be explained?
"I don't know all of the details myself, Adonis. But... you need to step away from that Magic Circle and let us talk about this more reasonably."
"What...?"
"I mean it, Adonis." Rey began to walk closer to the stupefied Hero. "Let's calmly discuss
this."
"Yeah... no... I don't know... I... why are you even here? What are you two doing here in the first place? Did you follow me? You followed me, only to stop me at this point?"
"No, that's not it." Rey said, hesitant to spill out the rest.
However, he decided to say his own side of the story, even if only out of goodwill towards one
of the few people he called friend.
"I actually-
"We're creating a portal that leads back to Earth for those who want to return." Lucielle beat him to it, summarizing everything as quickly as she possibly could.
"What?"
"Y-yeah, that's pretty much it."
"So... after accusing me of bailing on this world, you were planning to do the same?!" Adonis
gritted his teeth and took another step towards the Magic Circle.
"No!" Rey frantically responded. "The gateway is for Alicia! Alicia and anyone else
who doesn't want to stay here anymore and want to return to their normal life."
"You hypocrite!"
"I'm not! I know you want to save this world, Adonis! I do too." Rey tried to take a step
forward, but that only pushed the Hero away. "We can do this together, Adonis!"
"No..."
"It might be too late for your world, but would you really let this world die?"
"This is my world, Rey! And once I regress, I'll save everyone!"
"No..." Rey shook his head and sighed. "... You won't be saving anyone here, Adonis."
"I wi-"
"You'll just be running away."
At this point, Rey's pleading eyes and frantically desperate tone faded.
Replacing them was a cold expression.
He had a stiff face, with calculating eyes and a perfectly stoic demeanor-almost as if he had
lost all the emotions he had been displaying earlier.
"Adonis, I'll only say this once-stop what you're doing right now."
"You know I can't do that, Rey..." Adonis took one final step into the Magic Circle, now finding
himself at its very center.
"I have to-"
~WHOOOSH!~
Within the blink of an eye, Rey vanished from his position--using nothing but raw speed-
and appeared right in front of Adonis. He swiftly grabbed him by the face, launching him
away from the Circle before the latter could offer even the tiniest form of resistance.
In no time at all-
~THUD!~
-Adonis crashed on the incredibly sturdy ground, grunting and groaning as Rey stood on top
of him with his cool gaze.
"I told you... I'd only say it once."
*
*
[A/N]
Thanks for reading!
Is this going to be yet another big battle between Rey and Adonis? I wonder!
Also, we finally reached 900 chapters!
Yayyy!!!

chapters.title: Chapter 901: Absolute Defeat
chapters.content:
Chapter 901: Absolute Defeat
Adonis staggered to his feet, his breaths ragged and uneven.
The golden glow of his energy slowly began to rise and crackle. It illuminated the tension in the air, casting shadows across the ancient chamber. Rey stood unmoving, his calm demeanor a stark contrast to Adonis' frenzied state.
"[Perfect Divine Sword Summon]!" Adonis growled.
The radiant blade materialized in his grip, its brilliance pulsating with divine energy. Despite the exhaustion creeping into his limbs, his resolve hadn't wavered.
Rey stood a short distance away, his posture relaxed, yet his sheer presence felt
overwhelming. His face was stoic, his eyes cold and unyielding. He hadn't used a single skill, relying solely on raw strength and speed to dominate Adonis so far.
"Stay down, Adonis."
The Hero shook his head and kept growling. He tightened his grip on the golden sword, its radiant energy pulsating in his hand.
"I'm not giving up, Rey!" He yelled, the sound echoing through the chamber.
Rey tilted his head slightly, his expression unchanging. "You've already lost, Adonis. Stop this before it gets worse."
"Never!"
With a battle cry, Adonis launched himself forward, the golden blade cutting through the air as he activated another skill. "[Absolute Good Shall Prevail]!" he bellowed. A powerful surge of divine energy enveloped him, amplifying his speed and strength.
The ground beneath his feet cracked with the force of his push, and he closed the gap between them in an instant.
The Skill's effect was simple, but also complex.
As long as Adonis was doing something good, his power would skyrocket to the proportion of his conviction. In essence, it all depended on his will and unwavering resolve to do the right thing.
And at this moment... that was all that remained within him.
~WHUUUUUM!~
The strike came fast and hard, aimed directly at Rey's chest. But Rey moved with almost inhuman precision.
He sidestepped the attack effortlessly, the blade's edge slicing through empty air. Before Adonis could recover, Rey's hand shot out, grabbing his wrist in an iron grip.
Adonis gasped as Rey twisted his arm, forcing him to release the sword. It clattered to the ground, the divine energy dissipating as quickly as it had come.
"You're too slow," Rey said coldly, his grip tightening.
Adonis growled in frustration, summoning his mana for another attempt. "[Divine Light Magic]!" A blinding flash erupted from his outstretched hand, aiming to blind Rey and force him to let go.
Rey's expression didn't change. He didn't even flinch as the light engulfed them both. When the brilliance faded, Adonis found himself staring into Rey's unperturbed eyes.
"Is that all you've got?" Rey asked, his voice devoid of mockery but heavy with disappointment.
Adonis wrenched himself free, stumbling back a few steps. He activated [Perfect Full Sense], enhancing his perception to its maximum. Every detail of Rey's movements became crystal clear-the subtle shifts in his stance, the faint tightening of his muscles.
'I can do this,' Adonis thought, his confidence surging. 'I just have to outmaneuver him.'
He dashed forward again, his enhanced senses guiding him as he unleashed a flurry of strikes with his fists, each one charged with divine energy. The speed and precision of his attacks were unparalleled, each blow aimed at Rey's vital points.
But Rey was faster.
Effortlessly, he weaved through the onslaught, dodging and parrying with minimal movement. To an observer, it would have looked like a dance-Rey's fluid movements in stark contrast to Adonis's frantic assault.
In a blur of motion, Rey stepped inside Adonis's guard. His palm struck Adonis's chest with a resounding thud, sending him flying across the chamber. He crashed into the wall with enough force to leave cracks spreading through the ancient stone.
Adonis coughed, blood splattering onto the ground as he struggled to stand.
His mind raced, desperation clawing at him. "[Grand Magic Application]!" he groaned, summoning a barrage of magical projectiles that rained down on Rey from all directions.
The chamber filled with explosions as the attacks collided with the ground and walls, creating a cloud of dust and debris. For a moment, Adonis allowed himself a flicker of hope.
But as the smoke cleared, Rey emerged unscathed, his calm expression unchanged. He hadn't even moved from his spot.
Adonis's heart sank.
"You're wasting your energy," Rey said, taking a slow step forward. His presence alone seemed to sap the strength from the air.
Adonis clenched his fists, his body trembling with exhaustion.
'Damnit...' His thoughts echoed. 'If I use up too much energy here, I won't be able to activate the Ancient Magic. But, conserving energy isn't doing me any good here.'
In the end, Rey was just simply too strong.
'I have to risk it... I have to use more power!'
-VWUUUUUUSSHHH!!!~
Adonis activated [Heroic Power], pushing his body beyond its limits. A golden aura enveloped him, and his wounds began to heal. His strength returned in full force, and he prepared for
one final charge.
Rey stopped and raised an eyebrow. "You're persistent, I'll give you that."
With a roar, Adonis surged forward, every ounce of the power he could afford to use focused on this last attack. His golden aura blazed like the sun, and his movements became a blur as
he swung at Rey with everything he had.
Rey didn't even dodge.
Instead, he caught the incoming strike with one hand. The golden energy surged around him, crackling like a thunderstorm, but Rey remained unmoved. His grip tightened on Adonis's arm, and with a single, effortless motion, he slammed the Hero into the ground. The impact shook the chamber, and Adonis let out a choked gasp as the wind was knocked out of him. His aura flickered and died, leaving him splayed out on the floor, utterly defeated. Rey stood over him, his expression softening slightly. "Stop, Adonis. It's over." Adonis tried to move, to summon the strength for another attempt, but his body refused to respond. He lay there, staring up at Rey with a mix of anger and despair.
"You fought well," Rey said, his voice gentler now. "But you can't win this. Not against me."
Adonis closed his eyes, his breathing ragged as the weight of Rey's words settled over him.
The fight was over.
He had suffered an absolute defeat.
*
*
[A/N]
Thanks for reading!
Apologies for not posting all this time...
I suck, I know. However, I can only try to do better. Fingers crossed, all things considered.

chapters.title: Chapter 902: Is This Farewell?
chapters.content:
Chapter 902: Is This Farewell?
"Haa... haa..."
The chamber fell into an uneasy silence after Adonis lay motionless, his ragged breaths the only sound echoing in the vast, ancient room. Rey stood over him, his expression unreadable.
The overwhelming power he had displayed moments ago was now cloaked in a calm, yet authoritative demeanor.
Adonis tried to rise, but his body refused to obey. His defeat was absolute, and he knew it.
"Stay where you are," Rey said coldly, his voice cutting through the stillness.
A flick of his hand conjured a shimmering barrier around Adonis, trapping him within its confines. "This is for your own good. Rest and reflect on what's happened here."
Adonis didn't respond.
The fight had drained not just his body, but his spirit as well. His gaze was distant, a mix of anger and despair swirling in his eyes. He slumped back against the wall, his will to resist completely shattered.
Rey turned away, his focus shifting to Lucielle, who had been watching from the shadows. Her crimson eyes glimmered with a mix of relief but also worry.
'His overall demeanor has changed. Is he okay?' Her expression seemed to say. 'Is this what he meant about his emotions being suppressed?'
"It's time for the last phase of the plan," Rey said, his tone firm. "I need to inform Alicia and the others about the Transmigration Magic, so they're ready."
Lucielle nodded, her expression softening. "You're still set on staying here, aren't you?"
"I am." Rey's gaze flickered to the barrier containing Adonis. "This world still needs me, and I promised to fight for it. For everyone."
Her lips curved into a faint smile, and she stepped closer.
"You've always been kind, Rey. I think that's one of the reasons I..." She hesitated, then leaned in, placing a soft kiss on his cheek.
Rey froze, blinking in surprise.
Lucielle pulled back, her cheeks faintly flushed. "Thank you. For everything."
He rubbed the back of his neck awkwardly, his stoic demeanor briefly faltering. "I, uh—" "Go get Alicia," Lucielle interrupted, a teasing glint in her eyes. "I'll start working on the Magic Circle. Adrien's keeping guard outside, so you won't need to worry about any interruptions."
Rey hesitated, glancing between Lucielle and the barrier around Adonis. Finally, he nodded. "Fine. But don't push yourself too hard. The Magic Circle is a lot more complex than I expected, and with all the tampering Adonis must have done, it isn't going to be easy." "Pfft! Is that a consideration for me that I sense?" Lucielle chuckled. "You should have thought of that before bringing me into this."
"Haa... just get it done."
Lucielle gave him a mock salute. "When have I ever done anything halfway?"
He chuckled softly, the tension in the air easing slightly. With a wave of his hand, the barrier shimmered and tightened around Adonis, ensuring there was no way for him to interfere.
Adonis didn't even flinch, his defeated expression unchanged.
"Stay put," Rey said, more as a statement than a command.
Adonis didn't reply.
Satisfied, Rey vanished, leaving Lucielle alone in the chamber.
She sighed, her playful demeanor fading as she turned her attention to the task ahead.
"No time to waste..." She muttered, rolling up her sleeves and inspecting the intricate runes etched into the stone floor.
"This has to be perfect."
**********
In a dimly lit room on the far side of the fortress, Alicia sat on the edge of her bed, her hands clasped tightly in her lap. The room was modest, a stark contrast to the grandeur of the castle itself, but it was comforting in its simplicity.
Her thoughts drifted to Rey-his calm yet commanding presence, his unwavering resolve. She missed him more than she cared to admit.
A soft knock at the door snapped her out of her reverie, but before she could answer, space warped in the center of the room.
Alicia gasped, instinctively reaching for the dagger hidden under her pillow. But when the distortion settled, and Rey stepped through, her tension melted away.
"Rey?" Her voice was a mix of surprise and relief.
She tried to hide the red that was rising on her cheeks, and how flustered her rapidly beating heart had made her become. However, before she could succeed at that, she noticed the serious expression on Rey's face and worry soon crept in.
He nodded, his gaze steady. "We need to talk."
She stood, her brow furrowed in concern. "What's going on? Is something wrong?"
"It's time," he said simply. "Lucielle's preparing the Reverse Summoning spell to send you back to Earth."
Alicia's breath caught in her throat. "What?"
"It's what I have been working on in the Dragon Continent... or, at least one of the things."
"Rey..."
"Everything is ready now." Rey stepped closer, his voice firm but gentle. "I'm not sure, but this is the only chance we have to send you home safely. I wanted to make sure you knew and had time to say goodbye."
Her mind raced.
The idea of returning to Earth felt surreal, almost impossible after everything they had endured together in this world. "What about the others? Are they coming too?"
Rey's expression darkened slightly, and he shook his head. "I asked them. None of them want
to leave right now. They feel they still have a purpose here."
Alicia's heart sank. "So it's just me, then."
Rey nodded. "You're the only one who wants to return. And that's okay. You have a life waiting for you back on Earth."
She smiled sadly, tears brimming in her eyes. "It feels... strange. Saying goodbye like this. After everything."
"I know." Rey's voice softened, and for a moment, the weight of his decision was evident in his eyes. "But this isn't goodbye forever. I'll find a way to see you again. I promise." Alicia wiped her eyes, trying to compose herself. "You've always been terrible at goodbyes,
Rey."
He chuckled lightly. "You're not wrong."
She stepped closer, placing a hand on his arm. "Thank you, Rey. For everything. I'll never forget what you've done for all of us... and for me."
He nodded, the faintest hint of a smile on his lips. "Let's go."
Alicia took a deep breath and closed her eyes, steeling herself for the journey ahead. When she opened them again, her resolve was clear.
"I'm ready."
Rey extended his hand, and she took it without hesitation. The air around them crackled with energy as the space began to distort once more.
~VWUUUSH!~
In an instant, the two vanished, leaving nothing but an empty, quiet space behind.
*
*
*
[A/N]
Thanks for reading!
I suppose this is the end of the road for Alicia. It feels sad to see her go, though...

chapters.title: Chapter 903: True Love
chapters.content:
Chapter 903: True Love
~VWUUUM!~
As Rey and Alicia appeared, the distortion of space faded, leaving them standing amidst the ambient hum of Lucielle's nearly complete spellwork.
Lucielle was at the center of the chamber, her wings drooped, her horns faintly glowing as she stood over an intricate Magic Circle. Its pulsating energy filled the air with a heavy resonance, the kind that made the skin prickle and the heart race.
Sweat glistened on her brow, and her breathing was labored. The Rune was nearing completion, but it was clear she was paying a price for its creation.
Rey's eyes widened, his usual stoicism breaking. "Lucielle!"
She glanced up at him, her crimson eyes glassy with exhaustion. A weak smile touched her lips. "You're just in time," she said, her voice trembling but laced with triumph. "The portal... it's ready."
The runes on the floor flared brightly, and the Magic Circle came to life with a thunderous hum. Lucielle staggered, her knees buckling under her, but before she could collapse, Rey was there. He caught her, one arm under her shoulders, his other hand supporting her head.
"Lucielle, you pushed yourself too far," he muttered, his tone heavy with concern.
She gave a feeble chuckle, her head resting against his chest. "Don't... start lecturing me now. Just... just get Alicia home. That's all that matters."
Rey frowned but didn't argue. Instead, he carried her to a quiet corner of the chamber, conjuring a cushion of soft moss with a flick of his hand. He gently laid her down, his movements uncharacteristically tender. Lucielle sighed, her eyelids fluttering shut as she succumbed to the exhaustion.
As Rey stepped back, he felt the weight of someone's gaze and turned to see Alicia watching him. Her arms were crossed, and though her expression was neutral, there was a spark of something sharp-jealousy?-in her eyes.
Rey blinked, momentarily thrown. "What?"
"Nothing," Alicia said quickly, too quickly. She shook her head, forcing a smile. "Let's just... focus on this, okay?"
Rey hesitated, but the urgency of the moment won out. He closed the distance between them, his expression softening. "Are you ready?"
Alicia bit her lip, glancing at the glowing portal. Its energy twisted and churned like a living thing, its pull both terrifying and mesmerizing.
"I don't know," she admitted.
Rey's gaze was steady. "You've been waiting for this moment, Alicia. A chance to go home. To Earth."
She nodded, her heart heavy. "I thought I was ready. I really did. But now..." Her voice faltered, and she looked up at him, her eyes shining with unshed tears. "Now it feels wrong." "Alicia," Rey began, but she interrupted him, her voice trembling with emotion.
"Just let me say this, Rey. Please." She took a deep breath, her hands clenched into fists at her sides. "I've thought about this over and over again since you told me about the plan. I thought going home would be the easy choice. But the more I think about it, the more I realize I can't leave you behind."
Rey's eyes widened, and he opened his mouth to speak, but the words caught in his throat.
"I love you, Rey," Alicia said, her voice breaking. Tears streamed down her face, but she stood firm, her gaze locked on his. "I've loved you for so long, and I can't just walk away from you. Not now. Not ever."
Rey felt as though the world had tilted on its axis. Alicia's words hit him like a tidal wave, sweeping away the walls he'd so carefully built around his heart. He took a shaky breath, his voice barely above a whisper. "Alicia... you don't know what you're saying. Staying here... it's dangerous. You could get hurt-"
"I don't care!" she interrupted, her voice rising with raw emotion. "I don't care about the danger or the risks. What I care about is you, Rey. You're the only thing that matters to me."
He stared at her, his mind racing. Every instinct screamed at him to protect her, to send her home where she'd be safe. But another part of him, a part he had long buried, ached to hold onto her, to let her stay by his side.
"I've tried to push these feelings away," Alicia continued, her voice softer now. "I told myself I didn't deserve to feel this way about you, not when there was so much at stake. But I can't keep pretending. I love you, Rey, and I want to stay here—with you."
Rey closed his eyes, his jaw tightening as he fought to control the storm of emotions raging within him. When he opened them again, they were filled with a warmth Alicia had never seen before.
"I've spent so long trying to protect everyone, trying to shoulder everything on my own," he said quietly. "I thought that was what I had to do. But hearing you say this..."
He took a step closer, his voice trembling with honesty.
"It makes me realize I've been a fool. I've been running from my own feelings because I was afraid of losing you."
Alicia's breath hitched, hope flickering in her eyes.
"I love you too, Alicia," Rey admitted, his voice barely above a whisper. "I think I always have. But I was too afraid to say it. Too afraid to let myself feel it."
He felt his emotions get suppressed over and over, but the overwhelming emotions within him made it impossible for those feelings to evaporate.
All he felt within that moment... was pure love.
She took a step forward, closing the gap between them. "Then don't be afraid anymore." Rey hesitated for only a moment before he reached for her, his hand cupping her cheek. She leaned into his touch, her eyes fluttering shut as tears continued to fall.
"I promise I'll protect you," he said, his voice firm. "No matter what happens, I'll keep you safe. I won't let anything take you from me."
"I don't need you to protect me," she replied, her voice filled with quiet strength. "I just need you to be with me."
He smiled, a rare, genuine smile that softened his entire demeanor. "Then I'll stay with you. Always."
Their eyes met, and for a moment, the world around them seemed to fade away. The glowing portal, the hum of the Magic Circle, the weight of their responsibilities-all of it vanished, leaving only the two of them.
Rey leaned in, and Alicia closed the distance between them. Their lips met in a kiss that was both gentle and passionate, a silent confession of everything they had been too afraid to say.
Time seemed to stand still as they clung to each other, the kiss deepening as years of suppressed emotions came rushing to the surface. When they finally pulled away, they were both breathless, their foreheads resting against each other.
"I'm not going anywhere," Alicia whispered, her smile radiant despite her tears.
"And I'm not letting you go," Rey replied, his voice steady and filled with conviction.
They stayed like that for a moment longer, holding onto each other as if the world might crumble around them. For the first time in what felt like an eternity, they both felt a sense of peace-a sense of belonging.
Then-
~WHUM!~
All of a sudden, almost as if she was yanked away, Alicia was pulled away from Rey's embrace.
"Huh?!"
Her body floated away from him and towards a certain silhouette that had suddenly appeared at the entrance of the hall. It only took a fraction of a second-no, far less than that. Before even Rey could fully grasp the situation, she was right in the grasp of the intruder.
"Rey-!"

chapters.title: Chapter 904: Erosion
chapters.content:
Chapter 904: Erosion
"So you are THE Rey..."
The voice was deep and gentle, almost calm if one ignored the tinge of hatred that echoed subtly with every word that was spoken.
"It is a pleasure to meet you." He said with a smile.
The person who stood before Rey... who had Alicia in his grasp... was someone that Rey recognized. He had seen him once-during the Exchange, after the introduction of the
Dragon Emperor.
He was famed to be the most powerful Dragon-second only to the supreme Emperor of the Empire.
-The Great Old Dragon Lord.
"My name is S'ith, and I am the personal emissary of the Dragon Emperor, ruler of—"
"Let her go."
Rey's entire body was emanating a dangerous aura, one that materialized in the atmosphere as a dense covering of pure energy.
His eyes shone with pure bloodlust as he clenched his fist and prepared to step forward.
"I wouldn't do that if I were you..." The Old S'ith said with a cruel grin. "Take another step and she dies."
Rey was at crossroads once he heard those words.
'He's fast! I'm sure his Stats are higher than mine, and even with my passive skills active, he was able to get Alicia before I could even react.' Rey thought to himself nervously as he struggled to decide what to do.
His clashing emotions, coupled with their suppression, caused his mind to get overwhelmed with too much at the same time.
Unfortunately for him, this slight moment of hesitation would cost him.
... Very dearly.
"On second thought, I think I'll just skip the threats altogether."
The moment the Great Old Dragon Lord said this, Alicia's trembling body was suddenly pierced from behind by his fist, causing her body to turn limp and her tear-filled eyes to bulge as she made her last whisper.
"R-Rey... I..."
At that point, her face grew pale as the life swiftly drained from her body.
However-
~BOOOOOOOOMMM!!!~
-A swift eruption of power sent the entire Chamber of Ancients into an irreparable quake, and the sound of a loud explosion loudly pervaded the hall.
It all happened within the smallest fraction of a moment, but Rey's exploding speed thrust him forward, pushing away the Great Old Dragon Lord with his strongest punch as he reached out for Alicia's corpse.
~WHUUUUUM!~
Instantly, he coated himself in all of his power and did his best to activate as many skills as he held her in his hands.
"[Divine Weapon Creation]."
He created a garment around Alicia which had healing-no, rejuvenating properties.
No results.
"[Perfect Divine Magic]. [Divine Power Ascension]. [Perfect Domain Of The Divine]. [Perfect Divine Defense]. [Perfect Divine Appraisal]. [Divine Magic Interference]. [Tempora]. [Divine Persona]."
Useful or not, he threw every single skill he could into the mix.
No results.
He couldn't even use [Tempora] to reverse her situation because she was already dead.
"[Perfect Wish Fulfillment]"
He wished with all of his heart that Alicia would be well!
That the damage would be gone!
[SYSTEM ERROR!!!]
<Skill Usage Failed>
{Reasons: Task unable to register target as merely dead}
"[It Is Written]!" Rey screamed, trying to overturn the existing rules of his skills in order to accommodate this new change.
[SYSTEM ERROR!!!]
<Skill Usage Failed>
{Reason: Authority is insufficient to make such a change}
"[Command Code]. [Status Interference]. [Grand Luck]...!!!"
It went on and on.
"Please work! Anything work! Please just fucking work!"
Nothing was effective. Rey tried every single trick in the book, but none of it was effective in
the slightest.
Whatever death had been inflicted on Alicia... it was permanent.
"You're probably wondering why you can't revive her..." The same voice as before echoed in the hall almost amusedly.
Old Lord S'ith appeared, perfectly unscathed by the attack that had earlier been rendered on him by Rey. It almost seemed like he was brand new.
"You're strong, and you have a LOT of skills, but none of them are going to be effective here, Rey." The Lord smiled, his wrinkled face displaying even more of his cruelty. "The reason is
simple."
S'ith pointed at the corpse and increased his grin.
"That girl no longer exists."
As Rey's tear-filled eyes looked at the diminishing body of Alicia, watching as it crumbled into dust-no, nothingness-he felt seething emotions consume him.
"It's too late to save her, because there was no 'her' to begin with. The reason she is still here is because all time has been stopped in the immediate vicinity, and the moment a single moment elapses... she will completely disappear."
"A-Alicia... Alicia... no..." Rey mumbled to himself as he stubbornly held her, fighting off the words that were ringing in his ears.
"Even then, the change will eventually acclimate to the current paused time and whether you like it or not... you will see what the world has already accepted."
Once Rey blinked and opened his eyes... she was no more.
The same girl who was in his arms, who had kissed him and loved him... she was no longer
present.
"The girl is no more, boy!"
||
"Time to forget all about Alicia, and-"
"DON'T SAY HER NAME!" Rey screamed, tears gushing down his face as he screamed with so
much vigor, displaying every pathetic facet of himself to the enemy.
"Pfft! Or what?" The Old Dragon smiled, taking another step forward. "What can you possibly
do when you're about to join her?"
""
"Poor, poor Alicia. She chose a man who couldn't protect her in the end."
~ZZZTTZZ~
"It's a shame, really..."
[SYSTEM WARNING!]
<Erosion Rate Is Rapidly Increasing>
[SYSTEM WARNING!!]
<Erosion Rate's Increase Is Rising Beyond Previous Estimations>
[SYSTEM WARNING!!!]
<Erosion Is Nearly Complete>
[SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!]
[SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!] [SYSTEM WARNING!!!]
At this point, everything went silent.
The whole world became quiet as time resumed, and Rey rose to his feet, his face down and
his body completely still.
Slowly, he raised his head and stared at the Old Dragon Lord with empty eyes.
"I'm going to kill you."
*
*
[A/N]
Thanks for reading!
I hope you enjoyed the chapter, and... well... I reserve my comments.

chapters.title: Chapter 905: Crashout [Pt 1]
chapters.content:
Chapter 905: Crashout [Pt 1]
Alicia was gone.
The moment Rey accepted that, something broke inside him.
All of his emotions—his rage, grief, hatred... and so much more-vanished in the blink of an eye.
None of it was left.
'I... what have I been doing all this time?' Rey asked himself.
Despite his mission, despite his knowledge of the atrocities of the Dragons, there was a part of him that had considered them redeemable. He had hoped he could somehow change things and make the world better as a result.
'I was wrong.'
Rey could see it now-it was as clear as day to him.
'All Dragons are my enemies... and all my enemies are evil.' His cold mind calculated. 'So...'
It was clear to him now.
'... All Dragons are EVIL!'
The moment Rey accepted this, he felt a heavy weight being lifted from his body, and the last remnant of emotions within him-hope-vanished instantly.
Only one thing remained.
The Mission.
'ELIMINATE ALL DRAGONS!'
**********
S'ith stood across from Rey, his silver-like scales gleaming in the flickering light of the Chamber of Ancients.
"Kill me? Pfft! I must admit, I expected more from 'The Rey'... but all I see are empty threats."
He chuckled, taking a step forward.
In his mind, the old one couldn't help but rejoice at the cruelty he had just performed.
'I've successfully broken him. He might be strong, but his weak mind can't handle losing someone so precious.' His grin broadened. 'There's no doubt he'll lash out at me with clouded judgment.'
And once that happened, he would swiftly eliminate him.
"Now, are you going to just stand there, or-?"
Rey moved.
-B0000000000000000000000M!!! -
In an instant, the chamber exploded with motion. The floor shattered as Rey launched himself toward s'ith, his body trailing a surge of destructive energy.
S'ith raised his hand, manipulating the space between them to warp reality itself. The distance stretched infinitely, but Rey's sheer power tore through the distortion, closing the gap in an instant.
'Ahh... impressive!'
S'ith barely managed to sidestep as Rey's fist collided with the ground, unleashing a shockwave that obliterated the surrounding walls. The entire structure groaned under the pressure as debris rained down from above.
~RUMBLE!!!~
"You're faster than I thought," S'ith admitted, his tone still mocking as he warped space around himself, disappearing and reappearing at another corner of the chamber. "But speed is meaningless against the one who controls all time."
With a flick of his wrist, S'ith froze the world around him. Time came to a halt as he
approached Rey, his clawed hand raised to strike.
"You should have stayed down," he muttered as he aimed for Rey's heart.
But then, something impossible happened.
Rey's body twitched.
S'ith's eyes widened in shock as Rey broke free from the frozen time, his fist colliding with the Dragon Lord's chest. The impact sent S'ith flying through several walls, each one crumbling into dust as he crashed through them.
"How-?!"
Rey didn't give him time to finish. Appearing above S'ith mid-flight, Rey brought both hands down in a devastating blow. The Dragon Lord slammed into the ground, forming a massive crater that swallowed what remained of the chamber.
-B000000000000000000000000000000000MMMMMMM!!! -
S'ith rose from the rubble, coughing as golden blood dripped from his lips. His previously confident expression was replaced with one of disbelief.
"You... you're not supposed to be able to move in my domain!" he roared, spreading his arms wide.
The air around him rippled violently as time and space bent to his will.
This was the culmination of his two Perfect Divine Skills: [Perfect Divine Time Control] and [Perfect Divine Space Control].
With this power, he was able to completely erase Alicia by cutting her off at a particular moment in time and completely displacing her in time.
As a result, she never existed in the present.
But... what was this?
'My Perfect Divine skills have no effect on him for some reason.' The Great Old Dragon Lord thought to himself.
That meant Rey had reached-if not transcended-that level already.
'Since that's the case... I'll just overwhelm him with my Pure Stats.'
S'ith already knew that Rey was slower than him, and if the current strength he was displaying
was the limit of his power, then the boy still had ways to go before arriving at the his level.
'My Stats are all in the hundreds of thousands. He doesn't stand a cha-!"
"[Idle Gamble]... Full Return!"
Rey's chilling words echoed all across the shattered Chamber of Ancients, sending a shockwave of power spreading everywhere at once.
Then-
"Automatic Stat Distribution... activate."
-A true burst of power arrived.
~VWUUUUUUMMMM!!!~
The sheer intensity of the energy that was gathering around Rey was enough to make the
Great Old Dragon Lord shiver.
He had never felt so much energy before.
Except for one entity... One supreme entity.
'No! This can't be!' He growled, gritting his teeth as he decided to unleash his full power as well. 'I refuse to accept THAT!'
~B00000000000000000000000000000000000000000MMMMMMMMMMMMMMMMM!
!!!!!!!~
"I am the master of creation and destruction! The loyal herald of the ultimate Emperor of the
ultimate race! You cannot defeat me!"
Rey stepped forward, unfazed by the chaos.
His aura grew darker, denser, as if his very presence defied the laws of the world.
"You talk too much," he said coldly.
S'ith's laughter echoed in the ruins of the Chamber of Ancients. "Is that so? Well, why don't
you come and shut me up?"
It was clear what he wanted to do.
He was goading Rey, reeling him in like a hunter does with prey.
But, amidst everything, the boy was calm.
"Dragons..." He muttered, his voice low and cold.
S'ith paused mid-taunt, tilting his head. "Hm? What was that, boy?"
Rey raised his head to meet s'ith's gaze, his eyes devoid of any light.
"Dragons," he repeated, louder this time. "You're all the same. Arrogant. Cruel. Monsters
masquerading as something greater."
S'ith's grin wavered, if only for a second.
"Careful, whelp. You're treading on dangerous ground."
"Dangerous?" A hollow laugh escaped Rey. "There's nothing dangerous about you... or the
rest of your people."
The energy around him surged, crackling with uncontrollable fury. The air grew thick, the oppressive weight of his power warping the environment.
The remnants Chamber began to tremble, stones splintering and falling from the ceiling.
"You are all just evil."

chapters.title: Chapter 906: Crashout [Pt 2]
chapters.content:
Chapter 906: Crashout [Pt 2]
~BO000000000MMMM!!!~
The shaky ground beneath them shattered into a million and one pieces, and Rey surged forward in an instant, his fist colliding with S'ith's raised arm.
The impact sent a shockwave rippling through the Chamber, obliterating walls and reducing ancient carvings to rubble. S'ith was thrown back, his body crashing into the far wall with a thunderous boom.
Everything was reduced to ashes in an instant.
"Gah-"
"Be quiet." Rey cut him off, closing the distance between them before S'ith could recover. His hand shot out, grabbing S'ith's throat and slamming him into the ground. The earth caved beneath the force, creating a crater that swallowed S'ith.
S'ith struggled beneath Rey's grip, his eyes wide with a mixture of rage and fear.
'H-he's faster than me...? Stronger too!'
He tried to break the boy's grasp on his throat, but all that did was tighten it further.
Within a fraction of a moment, the two of them had left the Chamber of Ancients and Rey was now dragging him to the Capital Square.
"Do you realize what you're doing, boy? This is the capital! If you destroy everything—"
"Good," Rey hissed, tightening his grip. "Let it all burn."
"You're asking for a death sentence!"
The Chamber of Ancients masked the intense energy that Rey had exuded, but now that they were out in the open...
'... It's only a matter of time before reinforcements arri-'The Great Old Dragon Lord paused his relieved thoughts as he stared at Rey's empty eyes.
'Unless... that is what he wants. Don't tell me-?!'
~BOOOOOOOOOMMMM!!!~
Everything around them collapsed in a violent blaze of energy, searing the ground and incinerating everything it touched in an instant.
Within a single moment, the Square was no more.
"REY SKYLAR-!!!"
S'ith roared, his draconic strength finally breaking Rey's hold. He leapt back, his form shimmering as scales began to cover his body.
"You leave me no choice, whelp! You'll regret-"
Rey didn't let him finish.
"[Perfect Divine Ray]."
A blast of pure energy erupted from his hand, slamming into S'ith and sending him hurtling through the remnants of the Chamber.
S'ith crashed into the streets of the capital beyond, carving a deep trench in the stone.
Rey followed without hesitation, stepping through the rubble and into the chaos he had unleashed.
The once-bustling city was now a battlefield, its inhabitants fleeing in terror as his power ran rampant. Buildings crumbled, and the ground fissured under the weight of his wrath.
"U-ughh..."
S'ith rose from the debris, his form now fully transformed. His towering draconic body cast a massive shadow over the ruins, his silvery-golden scales shimmering in the light of the flames Rey had created.
"I admit you're stronger than me, boy!" S'ith bellowed, his voice reverberating like thunder. "But do you truly believe you can defeat me alongside the rest of my comrades?"
"I don't believe," Rey said, his voice cold and steady. "I know."
~WHOOOOSH!!!~
With a deafening roar, S'ith lunged at him, his massive claws slicing through the air. Rey met him head-on, his body a blur of motion as he evaded S'ith's strikes and countered with devastating blows of his own.
Each clash sent shockwaves rippling through the city, the sheer force of their battle leveling entire blocks.
Civilians screamed in the distance, their voices drowned out by the chaos that consumed all of them and ripped them to shreds.
Mere shockwaves were enough to kill dozens if not hundreds in a second.
It was a massacre!
"Do you see?" Rey muttered, catching S'ith's clawed hand and twisting it with enough force
to shatter the bones beneath his scales. "I don't need anything. I just need to kill you."
S'ith howled in pain, his massive form stumbling back. For the first time, true fear flickered in his eyes.
"You... You're not human," S'ith said, his voice trembling. "What are you?"
"I'm the one who's going to end you," Rey said simply, advancing with deliberate steps.
S'ith's confidence shattered completely. He turned, his massive wings unfurling as he prepared to flee.
'I-I can't win! I can't reach out to any of the other Lords! It's like I'm completely isolated! They might even know anything that's happening here!'
His thoughts went to the Dragon Emperor... as well as the one who tipped him off about Rey's presence in the capital.
None of them were around to help him now.
'I have to run!'
Those thoughts instantly echoed in his mind.
'If I can't win, and I'm not sure they'll come for me...' He can't his gaze in the direction of the fighting theater 'I'll just just have to go to them!'
"Oh no, you don't," Rey muttered, surging forward with a burst of speed that defied logic.
He appeared in front of S'ith, cutting off his escape.
"Where do you think you're going?"
S'ith froze, his massive body trembling as he realized there was no escape.
'If that's the case... then I'll just take you down with me!' His thoughts burst forth in determination as he glared at Rey with resolve.
He still had one more Perfect Divine Skill-one that was his trump card and also self-
sacrificial.
"[Perfect Divine Void]!"
In an instant, the entire area around both Rey and S'ith was swallowed in darkness-a pitch black void akin to a black hole.
"You and I will vanish forever as this void erases us! I won't let an existence like yourself be a threat to the Empire that is-!"
Before the Great Old Dragon Lord could utter another word, he was silenced by the impossible sight that manifested before him.
The void... was cracking.
"I-impossible..."
With a single step, Rey closed the distance between them again. The void itself continued to
shatter under the force of his mere presence.
A second more... and it collapsed entirely.
"Resistance is futile, and any further action is pointless..." Rey whispered as he looked down
on the paralyzed Dragon Lord. "All that's left is for you to die and suffer while doing so."
He grabbed the Dragon Lord by the throat and looked him dead in the eye.
There was no emotion, hatred, or any other feeling that could be clouding his judgment at
that instance.
Only one thing shone within those cruel abyssal eyes.
-Purpose.
"Die."

chapters.title: Chapter 907: Extra's Descent
chapters.content:
Chapter 907: Extra's Descent
"The White Dragon Lord has emerged victorious in the third exchange!"
Every spectator went crazy with cheers and a standing ovation as they witnessed the win streak of the White Dragon Lord-Head of the Dragon Academy, and one of the most esteemed Lords in the Empire.
There had been rumors of her downfall spreading around, but those were clearly false.
After all... not only had she defeated three various Dragon Lords in the three rounds she had fought in, but the opponent she just beat was none other than the Storm Dragon Lord- someone regarded as being nearly invincible.
"K-keuk..."
Vai'zel groaned as he struggled to rise back to his feet. The entire arena quaked as a result of the aftermath of the match, but his immediate environment trembled due to his growing embarrassment.
He never expected to lose at least, not to a weakling like the White Dragon Lord.
'What happened? What changed?!' His eyes seemed to ask as he stared at the victorious woman before him.
She had completely overwhelmed him.
"Now then... for her fourth and final fight... The White Dragon Lord will be facing none other than the Frost Dragon Lord-Lady Ce'leste!"
Everyone cheered as the biggest contender for prettiest Dragon stepped into the arena, her icy form and ethereal beauty captivating the audience.
No one could pick between Frey'ja and Ce'leste when it came to looks. One looked like a pure angel, and the other resembled an icy devil.
Since the Frost Dragon Lord rarely showed herself, the title for most beautiful usually went to the White Dragon Lord.
However, with the two now side by side, the crowd was at an impasse.
Unable to make the choice, they sat back and watched the two ladies prepare to fight-hoping desperately that the Lords could settle their superiority with this fight.
After all, the strongest would definitely be regarded as the most beautiful.
Everyone fell silent and watched with tense decorum.
"Let the Exhibition... begi-!"
~B0000000000000000000000000000MMMMMM!!!-
The excited, but serene atmosphereof the Dragon Arena shattered like fragile glass as a massive shadow hurtled through the sky, crashing into the ground with an earth-shaking impact.
Dust and debris erupted in all directions, cloaking the arena in a dense veil of smoke. The assembled dignitaries-a sea of Dragon Generals, emissaries, and noble clans from the Dragon Empire-stared in stunned silence.
The arena was meant to be the stage for a ceremonial exchange between the Dragon Lords, a revered event showcasing the Empire's unity and strength. Now, it had transformed into something akin to a battlefield.
-FSSHUUUUUUUU!!!~
As the dust began to settle, a collective gasp rippled through the crowd.
Lying at the epicenter of the crater was a bloodied and broken figure-a Dragon Lord. His once-proud scales were charred, his massive wings torn to tatters, and his aura dimmed to a faint, flickering ember.
He was barely recognizable, but his identity was unmistakable to those gathered. The Old Dragon Lord-the most powerful entity in the Empire aside from the Dragon Emperor-lay beaten and defeated, his battered body twitching feebly.
His voice was a faint rasp as he pleaded.
"M-mercy... please... help me..."
Above him, descending with an ominous stillness, was Rey.
His figure was wreathed in a pulsating, seemingly unreal energy-a crimson aura that radiated a pressure so intense it felt as if the air itself had been stripped of its life force. His gaze was cold and unyielding, his whitish silver hair catching the light like a blade drawn for execution.
The silence was oppressive, broken only by the Old Dragon Lord's labored breaths. "Who... who dares?" one of the Dragon Generals finally growled, stepping forward.
His voice trembled, though he masked it with bravado.
Rey didn't bother to answer. His piercing gaze swept over the gathered Dragon Lords, their entourages, and finally rested on the Dragon Emperor, who sat on his towering golden throne high above the arena.
The Dragon Emperor's eyes narrowed, and he leaned forward ever so slightly. His regal presence was formidable, yet even he seemed caught off guard by the sheer audacity of this
intrusion.
"HUMAN!"
The Storm Dragon roared, his voice deep and commanding. "You have trespassed in the heart of the Dragon Empire. Do you understand the gravity of your actions?"
Rey didn't respond immediately. Instead, he raised a single hand. The gesture was subtle, yet the power it exuded was anything but.
A group of Dragon Generals-meant to be the guards and welfare staff of the event-leapt into action, their instincts overriding their better judgment. They charged at Rey with weapons drawn, scales glowing with the power of their draconic lineage.
Each of them activated their strongest Skills as they attempted to close the distance in a flash.
They didn't get far.
-VWUUUUUUUUUUMMMM!!!~
The air around Rey shimmered, and an invisible force rippled outward.
In an instant, the charging Generals disintegrated, their bodies reduced to nothing more than ash. The residual energy from their obliteration left scorch marks on the arena floor.
"....?!!" The crowd recoiled in collective horror.
Even the Dragon Lords, the most powerful beings in the Empire stared in disbelief. The sheer effortlessness with which Rey had annihilated the Generals was unlike anything they had ever
witnessed.
"This is madness!" Vai'zel said once again, his voice tinged with both anger and fear. "Do you realize who you're facing? The might of the Dragon Empire-"
"I don't care."
Rey's gaze snapped to him, and the Dragon Lord's words died in his throat.
"Hahaha... you're insane! You think this will be anything like what happened in the Land of those Elves? That Old Lord might have gone easy on you, but-!"
"You will all face me," Rey interrupted his words coldly, his voice cutting through the tension like a blade. "Every last one of you. Dragon Lords, Generals, Emperor-none of you will leave
this place alive."
The declaration sent a shockwave through the arena.
The dignitaries in the stands exchanged nervous glances, their confidence in the Empire's supremacy beginning to waver. After being interrupted twice, his pride could no longer take the disrespect and fear he was experiencing, so Vai'zel stepped forward.
Emboldened by desperation and a strong desire to prove himself to his Emperor who was watching in disapproving silence, he shouted.
"You're just one foolish human! You can't possibly-"
Rey didn't let him finish.
~VWUUUSH!~
A crimson tendril of energy shot out from his aura, piercing the Storm Dragon Lord through
the chest and suspending him in midair.
"E-ehh...?" The Lord's eyes widened in shock and pain before his body crumbled into dust,
scattered by the wind.
The silence that followed was deafening.
"Next." He said.
The remaining Dragon Lords exchanged wary glances. One by one, they stepped forward,
forming a line right beneath the shadow of their Emperor's throne. Despite their fear, they could not allow this affront to go unanswered.
Frey'ja seemed particularly conflicted, but she stood beside her comrades as they faced the
obvious threat together.
"Together," The Frost Dragon Lord muttered, glancing at her comrades. "We take him
together."
Rey's aura flared in response, the crimson energy spiraling around him like a living entity. He tilted his head slightly, his expression unreadable.
"You think numbers will save you?" he said, his voice laced with disdain. "You're welcome to
try."
The dignitaries in the audience began to back away, sensing the imminent destruction. The arena, once a symbol of the Dragon Empire's unity, was now a battlefield poised on the brink
of annihilation.
Falling slowly from the sky, Rey landed right where the Old Dragon Lord's fragile body
remained.
In one simple descent-
~CRUNCH!~
-He ended the pathetic life of the miserable old creature.
Rey took a step forward, his movements deliberate and unhurried. His eyes burned with an intensity that seemed to pierce through the soul of everyone present.
"You have ruled for long enough..." He said, his voice echoing across the arena. "You have
basked in your power, your arrogance.
He coldly cast his gaze up, at the one who looked down on him from his place high above in
sheer silence-the Dragon Emperor.
"But now, your time has come."
K'arba'diel's expression darkened, and he finally opened his lips to speak.
"You are not the Hero..."
Rey stopped, standing in the center of the arena. The broken corpse of the Old Dragon Lord lay
right behind his feet, a stark reminder of his power.
"I don't need to be." He replied simply. "I am the one who will end you."
"Try."
-VWUUUUUUUSSSHHH!~.
The crimson aura around him surged, expanding outward in a wave of raw energy that shook
the very foundations of the arena. The Dragon Lords braced themselves, their scales glowing as they prepared for the inevitable clash.
Without wasting any time, they all transformed into their full Dragon form-their multiple horns rising as their colossal bodies cast dark shadows on Rey's lone form.
Despite the sheer intensity of that moment, he didn't show any hint of fear.
Instead, his gaze swept over them one final time.
"All of you..." Rey whispered, his voice low but carrying a weight that silenced the entire
arena.
"I'll kill you all."

chapters.title: Chapter 908: Rey Vs The Dragon Lords
chapters.content:
Chapter 908: Rey Vs The Dragon Lords
The sky above the Arena darkened as Rey's crimson aura surged, pulsing with an intensity that threatened to consume everything around him.
The gathered Dragon Lords, now in their true forms, towered over him, their colossal bodies blotting out what little light remained.
Despite their size and power, the tension and dread in the air was immense-a stark contrast to the unflinching cold in Rey's eyes.
The White Dragon Lord, Frey'ja, stood at the forefront, her majestic wings unfurling as her alabaster scales shimmered like divine light. To her left, the Frost Dragon Lord, Ce'leste, exhaled a frigid mist that crystallized the air around her. The new Dark Dragon Lord, X'ilerk, remained shrouded in shadows that seemed to warp the space they occupied, while the new Flame Dragon Lord, Pa'riana, burned with an inferno that scorched the ground beneath her.
Each of the remaining Dragon Lords emanated their own distinct aura, a testament to their might.
Yet, all their combined presence seemed insignificant before Rey.
The arena quaked as the first attack was launched. Pa'riana unleashed a torrent of fire, a molten wave that consumed everything in its path.
-BO0000000000MMMM!!!~
The intense heat melted the arena floor, turning stone into liquid magma. The flames roared toward Rey with ferocity, yet he stood motionless. As the inferno closed in, his aura flared.
With a simple gesture, he extended a hand, and the flames bent to his will. The fire spiraled into the air, twisting and compressing into a dense orb of molten energy. Rey clenched his fist, and the orb imploded, extinguishing Pa'riana's attack as though it were a mere candle.
Before the Flame Dragon Lord could react, Rey vanished.
A crimson blur shot through the air, and in an instant, he was upon her. His hand, wreathed in destructive energy, pierced through her massive chest.
The Flame Dragon Lord roared in agony, her fiery breath faltering as her life force drained away.
With a flick of his wrist, Rey sent her corpse hurtling across the arena, where it crashed into the stands, obliterating several rows of spectators in an explosion of fire and blood. ~BAM!~
The crowd screamed, but Rey paid them no mind.
The Forest Dragon Lord, M'ordum, roared in fury, vines and roots erupting from the ground to entangle Rey.
The living tendrils were as thick as pillars, their surfaces glowing with ancient runes that pulsed with natural energy. They wrapped around Rey's limbs, constricting with enough force to crush steel.
"DIE, FOOLISH HUMAN!"
M'ordum bellowed, channeling his power to summon a massive tree that burst from beneath the arena, its trunk reaching the heavens.
But Rey's power was absolute.
The crimson aura around him surged, and the vines disintegrated, unable to withstand the corrosive energy.
The colossal tree splintered and fell as Rey shot toward M'ordum like a crimson meteor. His fist connected with the Forest Dragon Lord's head, and the force of the impact obliterated it entirely.
M'ordum's headless body collapsed, shaking the earth as blood soaked the arena floor.
The Sea Dragon, Mi'riam, attempted to take advantage of the chaos.
A tidal wave materialized above the arena, conjured by her massive form as she soared overhead. The water, imbued with her draconic power, surged with enough force to drown entire cities.
As the wave descended, Mi'riam unleashed a piercing roar that shattered the remaining fragments of the arena.
Rey looked up, unbothered by the impending deluge. He raised a hand, and the wave froze mid-descent.
With a flick of his fingers, the frozen water shattered into a rain of icy shards. Mi'riam recoiled, her massive body twisting to avoid the shards, but Rey was already above her. His aura flared, and a crimson blade formed in his hand.
One swift slash cleaved through the Sea Dragon, her body splitting in two and crashing to the ground below.
~SPLOOOOOSH!!!~
The Frost Dragon Lord, Ce'leste, and the Dark Dragon Lord, X'ilerk, acted in unison. Ce'leste unleashed a blizzard so cold that the arena was encased in frost within seconds, the temperature plummeting to levels that would freeze even the strongest beings.
X'ilerk followed with a wave of pure darkness, a void that consumed light and threatened to erase existence itself.
The combined assault enveloped Rey, the two Dragon Lords pouring all their power into their attack. The other Lords held back, watching with grim satisfaction as the overwhelming energy engulfed the human.
But Rey emerged unscathed.
~VWUUUUUSHHHH!!!~
His aura expanded, a pulsating sphere of crimson energy that devoured the frost and darkness. The blizzard dissipated, and the void was consumed by the raw power emanating
from him.
Rey's form was illuminated by his aura, his expression colder than the frost that had surrounded him.
Ce'leste's eyes widened in disbelief as Rey appeared before her.
She raised her claws, encased in ice, to strike, but he caught them effortlessly. With a single motion, he crushed her claws, the sound of shattering ice echoing through the arena. He drove his hand through her chest, shattering her core.
"AHHHHH!!!"
The Frost Dragon Lord let out a final, pitiful roar before collapsing into a heap of frozen flesh.
X'ilerk attempted to retreat, his shadowy form flickering as he tried to escape. But there was no escape from Rey.
The crimson energy around him surged, forming tendrils that shot out and ensnared the Dark Dragon Lord. X'ilerk struggled, his shadowy body writhing against the binding energy, but it
was futile.
~SQUELCH!~
The tendrils constricted, crushing the life out of him until he was nothing more than a
smoldering husk.
One by one, the Dragon Lords fell.
The arena was a ruin, the ground scorched and shattered, the air thick with the stench of blood and ash. The surviving spectators fled in terror, but many were caught in the collateral destruction, their bodies disintegrated by the residual energy of the battle.
Only one Dragon Lord remained.
Frey'ja, the White Dragon Lord, stood amidst the devastation. Her once-pristine form was battered and bloodied, her wings torn, and her aura flickering weakly.
She looked at Rey, her eyes wide with fear.
"I... I yield..." she stammered, her voice trembling. "Please... show mercy..."
Rey stepped toward her, his footsteps deliberate and unhurried.
The ground beneath him cracked with each step, his presence suffocating. Frey'ja fell to her knees, her majestic form diminished to that of a broken, pleading creature.
"Mercy?"
Rey's voice was cold, devoid of emotion. He stood over her, his crimson aura swirling around
him like a living entity.
"Did you show mercy to those you deemed beneath you?"
Frey'ja sobbed, her tears mixing with the blood that stained her scales. "Please... spare me..."
Rey's gaze remained unyielding. He raised his foot and brought it down with all the force of his overwhelming power.
The White Dragon Lord's plea ended in a sickening crunch.
She died.
Rey stood amidst the carnage, the bodies of the Dragon Lords scattered around him, their once-great forms reduced to lifeless husks. The arena was unrecognizable, a smoldering wasteland that bore the scars of his wrath.
The capital trembled, the very earth quaking beneath the weight of his destruction. Through it all, the same ringing sound and System Panels kept appearing before Rey's
unbothered eyes.
[You Have Leveled Up].
[You Have Leveled Up].
[You Have Leveled Up].
[You Have Leveled Up]. [You Have Leveled Up]. [You Have Leveled Up].
On and on, it kept buzzing and filling his field of vision.
'What Level am I now...?' He wondered to himself.
He didn't know... and he didn't care.
Instead, he looked up toward the Dragon Emperor, who had remained silent throughout the
massacre.
Their eyes met, and for the first time, the Emperor's expression faltered.
Rey's voice, cold and unwavering, echoed through the ruins.
"Your turn."

chapters.title: Chapter 909 Singularity Vs Dragon Emperor
chapters.content:
"So… you really did it."
As the words of the Dragon Emperor echoed in the hall, a thunderous effect permeated everything that remained in the desecrated vicinity.
Nothing but corpses and devastation surrounded Rey as he cast his gaze on the Emperor.
Instinctively, his Appraisal kicked in.
[STATUS WINDOW]
- Name: K'arba'diel
- Race: Dragon Royal (Transcendent)
- Class: Dragon Emperor (SS-Tier)
- Level: 999 (Max)
- Life Force: 999,999
- Mana Level: 999,9999
- Combat Ability: 999,999
- Stat Points: 0
- Skills (Exclusive): [Reset]
- Skills (Non-Exclusive): [World Destruction]. [All Magic]. [Perfect Domain]. [Complete Dominion]. [Evil Personified].
- Alignment: Chaotic Evil
[Additional Information]
The destroyer of the world, and herald of the will of chaos. He is the ultimate enemy of H'Trae, and the absolute deity of the Dragons.
Destroy this vile entity and restore balance to the world.
[End Of Information]
Just like The Oracle, he was a Transcended being who had reached the very limits of power allowed by the world.
There was no way anyone could defeat such a being.
Unless—
"Shut up!"
The air crackled with unrelenting energy as Rey hurtled toward the towering spire where the Dragon Emperor K'arba'diel sat.
